title: Uncles Peter (violin) and Honore (drums)
summary: Dutre identifies his two musical uncles; Russell notes Baby Dodds called Honore 'Nora'.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Also, I was going to ask a little bit about your uncles. You had two uncles that played music. I understand, was it Peter was the violin?
Peter was the violin and the honoree was the drum on us.
How do you pronounce that? Honoree?
Honoree. Because I know Baby Dodds in Chicago who worked with him always called him Nora.
That was a nickname. Yeah, Norae.
